Dīghanikāya
or Dīghāgama or Dīghasaṅgaha. Bud. first Book of Suttapiṭaka; in 44 long suttas of three vargas: Sīlakkhandha, Mahāvagga, an. Pātheya or Pāthikavagga.
For a general account of the work see Wint., HIL. II. p.. 35-46; for a summary of the suttas see B. C. Law, A His.. of Pāli Lit. I. p.. 80-115; also B. C. Law, ‘A study of Dīgha Nikāya of the Suttanipāta’, Young East, IV. (Tokyo) 1928-29. p.. 111-20; on the mutual relation of the suttas see

(1913) p.. 409-61.
